channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: Rivian R2 First Drive: Kyle Conner Spends Two Hours Finding Out How Good It Really Is
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: The powertrain architecture is inverted from the R1: rear-primary, disconnecting front axle, and it shows. Kyle Conner drove on-road and off-road sections, ran a charging session at a Rivian Adventure Network stall, and came back with a two-hour verdict.

item.title: Rivian R2 Driven: Why It Doesn't Drive Like a Smaller R1S
item.dc:creator: Kim Java
item.description: Two thousand pounds lighter than the R1S and built on a completely separate midsize platform, the R2 does not behave like a shrunken version of anything. Java drove on-road and off-road sections and pressed RJ Scaringe on the $45,000 model take rate and autonomy timeline.

item.title: Two Tesla Model Y Owners Drive the Rivian R2 and Keep Their Reservation
item.dc:creator: Everyday Chris
item.description: Everyday Chris has owned two Model Ys for nearly a decade and put down an R2 reservation two years ago. The reservation survives contact with the actual vehicle. The honest answer to R2 versus Model Y is that they are for different buyers.

item.title: Rivian R2 Engineering Explained: The Chief Engineer Walks Through Every Compromise
item.dc:creator: savagegeese
item.description: Chief engineer Max Kauf explains what Rivian traded away to hit the R2's price point and what they kept. The shift from body-on-frame to unibody, from air suspension to semi-active dampers, from 50/50 to 40/60 rear-bias torque split, all of it is on camera here.

item.title: An R1S Owner Drives the Rivian R2 and Comes Away With One Clear Verdict
item.dc:creator: Gjeebs
item.description: Gjeebs already owns an R1S, so the comparison is direct. His conclusion after driving the R2 at elevation in Utah: lighter, more agile, costs about half as much, and does not feel like a cheaper version of anything. The R2 is a different kind of Rivian.

item.title: Rivian R2 Launch Day: Order Invitations Are Going Out Now
item.dc:creator: Rivian
item.description: June 9 is here. Rivian has started sending R2 order invitations, demo drives are open for booking, and the first vehicles are heading to driveways. Performance trim with Autonomy+ is the first available to order.

item.title: Fox ESS High Voltage Solar Kit: The First High Voltage System The Solar Lab Actually Recommends
item.dc:creator: The Solar Lab
item.description: The Solar Lab has tested every major high voltage residential solar kit. The Fox ESS 9.6 kW inverter and stackable battery system is the first one they would actually recommend. Big market share in Europe, new to North America.

item.title: EGO Aura R2 Robotic Mower Review: RTK Navigation, No Boundary Wire, Up to 6,000m2
item.dc:creator: Machinery Nation
item.description: EGO's first robotic mower uses RTK satellite navigation, LiDAR, and cameras to map lawns without a boundary wire. Machinery Nation puts the Aura R2 to work on a real garden for several days.

item.title: Donut Lab Has Missed Every Deadline It Set and Gone Quiet. Where Did the Battery Revolution Go?
item.dc:creator: Ben Alexxander
item.description: In January 2026, Donut Lab claimed 400 Wh/kg, 5-minute charging, 100,000 cycles, and Q1 production deliveries. Every deadline has passed with no independently verified evidence and no customer deliveries.

item.title: A 2012 Tesla Model S Gets More Software Updates Than a 2024 Porsche Macan EV. That Is a Problem.
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: Out of Spec Reviews makes the case that EV software strategy has become the line between a great car and a frustrating one. Three ownership experiences, from a 2012 Model S to a 2024 Macan EV, drive the point home.

item.title: BMW iX3 vs Mercedes CLA: 500 Miles, One Charge, and a Very Long Drive North
item.dc:creator: Autotrader UK
item.description: Autotrader UK drives the BMW iX3 and Mercedes CLA 250 Plus from Northampton toward Scotland on a single charge. Real-world range lands at 429 and 434 miles. The petrol camera car stops at the same distance.

item.title: How Regenerative Braking Actually Works: The Physics Behind Slowing Down to Charge Up
item.dc:creator: Jeremy Fielding
item.description: Engineer Jeremy Fielding builds a custom flywheel rig to demonstrate how electric motors become generators under braking, and what the real range gains and brake pad savings look like in practice.

item.title: The Tesla Model Y Is Cheap to Run But Not Always Cheap to Own
item.dc:creator: Everyday Chris
item.description: Five years of real Model Y ownership data: fuel savings are genuine, but California insurance, EV registration fees, load-rated tires, and cracked glass complicate the total savings story significantly.

item.title: Europe's EV Market Share Is Surging: Norway at 98%, France Nearly Doubles Year-on-Year
item.dc:creator: The Electric Viking
item.description: May 2026 European EV registration data: Norway 98%, Denmark 95.8% among private buyers, France 29% up from 16%, Italy registrations up 76%. The anti-EV media narrative from last year is not holding up.

item.title: Rivian R1T Tows a 38-Foot Triple-Axle Trailer and Makes It Look Straightforward
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec BITS
item.description: A four-year-old R1T with 128 kWh of usable capacity hauls a massive empty triple-axle bumper pull 70 miles. Efficiency drops to one mile per kWh. Key lesson: aerodynamic profile crushes EV towing range, not trailer weight.

item.title: The Ferrari Luce Costs $640,000 and Nobody Can Agree on Whether It's Ugly
item.dc:creator: Waveform Clips
item.description: Marques Brownlee drove the Ferrari Luce before its reveal and he still can't fully defend the design. The Waveform crew breaks down why $640,000 raises the stakes on every styling choice.

item.title: Ford Built the Plug-In Off-Roader Americans Want, Then Made It Only for China
item.dc:creator: InsideEVs
item.description: The Ford Bronco New Energy is a camping-ready plug-in off-roader with 748 miles of EREV range starting at $33,000. Tariffs and Chinese tech bans mean it stays in China.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
